method: Static recompilation of Xbox 360 PowerPC machine code through ReXGlue, plus native host renderer and platform integration
observations: A substantial usable-port effort with published beta packages for Linux, Windows and Apple Silicon macOS; author reports menus, dungeons, inventory, pets and saves.

Gameplay code is generated from default.xex into ignored generated/. Public host hooks keep PPCContext registers, guest memory, byte-swapping and address-named functions; this is compiled translation, not a CPU interpreter.
This does not reconstruct the original PC Linux C++98 translation units, classes and method bodies targeted by OpenTorchlight.
Host renderer uses OGRE 14.6 while guest ABI maps describe OGRE 1.7.0 on 32-bit big-endian PPC/MSVC. Layouts and offsets cannot be copied to our OGRE 1.6.5/GCC Linux ELF.
The October 13 v0.7.6-beta release lists Android for a next iteration; no Android release was established by this review.
Generated gameplay source is absent from public Git and requires the original XEX. The XEX also appears in verified installed runtime inputs.
Published gameplay/performance reports are author evidence, not our independent launch or proof of completing the full game. The ordinary CI uses nogame builds.
implication: The practical modern-platform and eventual Android goals overlap substantially. Compare this port before funding another long recovery tranche; readable-original-source recovery remains a separate deliverable.
potential_reuse: Independent format and ABI research, checked against our original before use
